int_name: N BROAD ST & W SUSQUEHANNA AVE

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with commercial buildings and marked zebra crosswalks. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the crossing distance is significant and lacks physical protection like medians or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are worn, potentially reducing visibility for approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the width of the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features a very wide roadway with multiple travel lanes, significantly increasing pedestrian exposure time. While traffic signals and marked crosswalks are present, the lack of refuge islands and the presence of large vehicles obstructing sightlines create a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the main roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large garbage truck parked near the corner obscures the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: This is a wide multi-lane urban arterial with signalized intersections and marked but faded crosswalks. The environment is heavily oriented toward vehicle throughput, resulting in long crossing distances and high exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a signalized crossing, but the crosswalk markings are significantly faded. The environment is primarily commercial with street trees, yet lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and modern safety enhancements like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is significantly worn, making it less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from the driver's view.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Apply thermoplastic continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.
